eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Chelan, WA; at 8:38 PM on AUG 15, 2020 Effective until 9:38 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Chelan County Sheriff office has issued a be on the look out for suspect of an assault. Travis G Hodosko white male 5 feet 6 inches bushy hair and beard.  wearing a plaid shirt and tan pants. Suspect has a 20 month old child with him. Child last seen wearing striped blue yellow shirt and gray pants, has brown curly hair, green eyes and has a scab on his chin. If seen contact 9 1 1.
